info.title: Auxilia API
info.description: Tenant and platform API of Auxilia. Errors are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails with errorCode (AUX-NNNNN) and traceId.

post.summary: Signs in with a password or an e-mailed code, or exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair
Ends the session of the access token and revokes its tokens
Activates an account with the token of the activation link and sets its password
Sends a password reset link when the user exists (always 202)
Sets a new password with the token of a reset link and ends the user's sessions

get.summary: Sign-in methods enabled for the tenant (password, email-otp)
The password rules of the tenant

post.summary: E-mails a one-time sign-in code when the method is enabled (always 202 for any user name)
Changes an expired password with the current one and signs in

get.summary: The signed-in user, the tenant, every role and the effective permissions
Menu of the tenant app for the signed-in user (visible modules, roles and permissions)

post.summary: Changes the own password (current one required); the other sessions of the user end

get.summary: The own profile: name, e-mail, phone, read-only user name, language, theme and picture version

put.summary: Changes the own first and last name, e-mail and phone (the user name stays)
Sets the own language (an active language of the tenant), also for the next sign-ins
Sets the own theme: System, Light or Dark
Uploads the own picture (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB); stored resized to at most 400 × 400

delete.summary: Removes the own picture

get.summary: The own open sessions, most recently used first; the current one is marked

delete.summary: Ends one of the own sessions: its tokens stop working and its connections sign out

get.summary: The picture of a user (own picture, or any user's for staff) with its hash as ETag

post.summary: Starts the TOTP enrolment of a platform user with the activation token (secret shown once)
Sets the password and confirms the authenticator with a current code
Console sign-in with password and authenticator code, or refresh of the console tokens
Ends the console session and revokes its tokens (tenant-scoped ones included)

get.summary: The signed-in platform user
Tenants of the platform with their plan (archived ones with includeArchived=true)

post.summary: Creates a tenant and queues its provisioning (202); the first Administrator is invited by e-mail

get.summary: Active plans with their modules per role

post.summary: A short-lived platform token for the technical endpoints of one tenant

get.summary: A tenant (archived included) with its plan and its latest provisioning and migration runs

put.summary: Changes name and time zone of a tenant

post.summary: Queues the provisioning again for a tenant in Provisioning or MigrationFailed
Suspends an active tenant (its users cannot sign in)
Reactivates a suspended tenant
Archives a tenant: read-only, never deleted (D-25)

put.summary: Moves the tenant to another plan from now on

get.summary: Modules of the tenant: plan roles, override and effective roles

put.summary: Overrides the plan for one module of the tenant (enabled for some roles, or disabled)

delete.summary: Removes the override: the module follows the plan again

get.summary: Events of the tenant's daily log files, newest first, by date range (UTC days, at most 31) and filters
The default log level and, while it runs, the end of the tenant's debug logging

put.summary: Writes the tenant's Debug events until the given instant (within 24 hours); it ends by itself

delete.summary: Back to the default log level for the tenant now

get.summary: Active languages of the tenant, default first
Translations of a language (key → text; fallback: tenant default language, English, the key) with ETag
Every language with its translated and missing keys
Categories of the translation keys and their number of keys
Translation keys, searched by key or text, filtered by category or missing language

post.summary: Adds a translation key, optionally with its first translations

get.summary: A translation key with its translations

put.summary: Changes category and description of a translation key

delete.summary: Deletes a translation key and its translations

put.summary: Sets the translation of a language (marked as customised for the tenant)

delete.summary: Removes the translation of a language (clients get the fallback)

get.summary: Administrator accounts of the tenant and whether they are activated

post.summary: Creates the first Administrator of the tenant and e-mails the invitation (pending without a sending account)
E-mails a new activation link to an Administrator who has not activated the account

get.summary: Settings of the tenant with default, platform, tenant and effective value

put.summary: Sets the tenant-level value of a setting

delete.summary: Removes the tenant-level value, so the platform value or the default applies again

get.summary: Branding of the tenant: app name, theme, login background and image versions
A branding image (logo or background) with its hash as ETag

put.summary: Uploads the logo (≤ 512 KB) or the login background (≤ 2 MB): PNG, JPEG or WebP

delete.summary: Removes the logo or the login background image

get.summary: Entities whose records carry custom fields
Custom field definitions, optionally of one entity, by entity then order

post.summary: Adds a custom field to an entity

put.summary: Changes a custom field (entity, key and type stay)

delete.summary: Removes a custom field (stored values are no longer shown)

get.summary: Grids of the tenant app with their columns and the layout of every role

put.summary: Sets the columns a role sees, in their order

delete.summary: Removes the layout of a role: the default columns apply again

get.summary: Columns of a grid for the signed-in user (layout of the first of the user's roles that sees it)
Custom field definitions of an entity, for forms, details and grids
Sending accounts of the tenant (without secrets)

post.summary: Adds a sending account; the first of a channel becomes its default

put.summary: Changes name and settings; an empty secret keeps the stored one

post.summary: Makes the account the default of its channel

put.summary: Activates or deactivates the account (the default stays active)

post.summary: Sends a test message now and records it in the outbound log with its outcome

get.summary: Sender rules (channel, purpose, role → account), optionally of one channel

put.summary: Replaces the sender rules of a channel

get.summary: Outbound log, newest first, filtered by channel, status, account and recipient
Permissions declared by the modules with the roles holding them and their default roles

put.summary: Sets every permission a role holds

delete.summary: Gives a role the default permissions of the modules again

get.summary: Active specializations, optionally of one role, by role then name

post.summary: Adds a specialization of the Client or Employee role

put.summary: Changes a specialization (the role stays)

delete.summary: Deactivates a specialization (it keeps its members)

get.summary: Users holding the specialization, by user name

post.summary: Gives the specialization to users of its role

get.summary: Users of the specialization's role who do not hold it (at most 50), matching the search

delete.summary: Takes the specialization away from a user

get.summary: The captcha challenge the client application must solve before sending a registration (403 when registrations are closed)

post.summary: Sends a registration request for staff review (one pending request per e-mail)

get.summary: Registration requests filtered by status, request date and text (name, surname, e-mail, fiscal code)
Login audit: every sign-in attempt, filtered by user name, method, result and date range
Clients, all or mine (view=mine), filtered by name, surname, e-mail, user name, phone, status and employee

post.summary: Creates a client (e-mail = user name); by an Administrator it can sign in and gets the activation e-mail

get.summary: Employees a client can be assigned to (Employee role, can sign in)
Active specializations of the Client role a client can be given
A client: personal data, account, employee in charge with history, specializations

put.summary: Changes personal data, user name and custom fields of a client

delete.summary: Deletes a client (soft delete): hidden from the lists, sign-in disabled

put.summary: Enables or disables the client's sign-in; enabling needs an employee in charge
Hands the client to an employee (the previous assignment ends, history kept)

delete.summary: Nobody in charge of the client from now on

put.summary: Replaces the client's Client specializations

post.summary: E-mails a new activation link to a client who has not activated the account
E-mails a reset link, or sets a temporary password shown once (changed at the next sign-in)

get.summary: Employees filtered by name, surname, e-mail, user name, phone and status (active/inactive)

post.summary: Creates an employee (e-mail = user name); with sign-in enabled the activation e-mail leaves at once

get.summary: Administrators an employee can report to (Administrator role, can sign in)
Active specializations of the Employee role an employee can be given
An employee: personal data, account, default flag, administrator, specializations, workload

put.summary: Changes personal data and user name of an employee

delete.summary: Deletes an employee (soft delete): sign-in disabled, clients handed to the default employee

put.summary: Enables or disables the employee's sign-in; the default employee cannot be disabled
Makes the employee the default one, who receives the clients created without an employee
Replaces the employee's Employee specializations
Sets the administrator the employee reports to

delete.summary: The employee reports to no administrator from now on

post.summary: E-mails a new activation link to an employee who has not activated the account
E-mails a reset link, or sets a temporary password shown once (changed at the next sign-in)

get.summary: A registration request

post.summary: Approves a pending request: creates the client (user name = e-mail), assigned to the default employee, and sends the activation e-mail
Rejects a pending request with optional notes; no client is created

get.summary: Every service category by name, inactive ones included, with the number of services using it

post.summary: Creates a service category (name unique among the active ones)

put.summary: Changes name, description and active state of a category

delete.summary: Deletes a category no service uses; otherwise 409 (deactivate it instead)

get.summary: Services filtered by name, category, specialization and active state, sorted by name, price or duration

post.summary: Creates an active service (price in euro, duration in days, optional category and Employee specialization)

get.summary: A service with its category and specialization

put.summary: Changes a service, including its active state, category and specialization

delete.summary: Deletes a service (soft delete); a service in use is deactivated instead

get.summary: The folder template of a service in tree order, with depth and path

post.summary: Adds a folder at the end of its siblings (root when parentId is null); answers with the template

put.summary: Sets the order of every folder under one parent; answers with the template
Renames a folder (unique among its siblings); answers with the template

delete.summary: Deletes a folder and its subfolders; answers with the template

get.summary: The cases the caller may see (F10), filtered by client, service and status, with the show all / show completed toggles

post.summary: Opens a case for a client and an active service (price snapshot, number {year}-{sequence})

get.summary: A case with client, service, timeline, payments and what the caller may do

put.summary: Changes the due date and the custom fields of a case not completed

delete.summary: Deletes a case (soft delete) and recomputes the client status

post.summary: Moves a case one status forward (Inserted → InProgress → Sent); a sent case is completed instead
Moves a case one status back (from InProgress or Sent)
Completes a sent case with the amount received and the outcome; then it never changes
Records money received for a case not completed

get.summary: Documents the caller may see (F10), filtered by client, case, folder, name, year, area, description and uploader

post.summary: Uploads files for a client, optionally a case and a folder of its service, with the same metadata

get.summary: A ZIP of the documents of a case, or of one folder subtree (folder paths kept)
A document with its folder path and what the caller may do

put.summary: Changes name (extension kept), reference year, area, description and custom fields

delete.summary: Deletes a document and its file

get.summary: The file; inline=true shows PDF and images in the browser, any other type is downloaded

put.summary: Moves a case document to another folder of the case's service, or to none

get.summary: Every document area by name, inactive ones included, with the number of documents

post.summary: Creates a document area (name unique among the active ones)

put.summary: Renames or (de)activates a document area

get.summary: The appointments the caller may see, filtered by client, employee, status and local days

post.summary: Staff schedule an appointment for a client (approved; employees only for the clients in charge)

get.summary: The appointments of a range of local days (at most 62): the caller's own or, for staff, the global calendar
Staff: the open appointments of an employee overlapping a slot (a warning, never a block)
Clients: the active employees an appointment can be requested with, the one in charge marked
An appointment with its timeline, conflict warning (staff) and what the caller may do

put.summary: Moves or edits a pending or approved appointment (a new start must be in the future)

delete.summary: Staff delete an appointment (soft delete, history kept)

post.summary: A client requests an appointment with an employee (pending until approved or rejected)
Approves a pending appointment
Rejects a pending appointment
Completes an approved appointment
Cancels a pending or approved appointment (staff or the client)

get.summary: The inbox: requests received (employee: addressed to me; Administrators: the office), sent, or all (Administrators)

post.summary: Clients ask the employee in charge (default) or the office; employees ask the office

get.summary: A request with its thread and what the caller may do

delete.summary: Administrators delete a request (soft delete, thread kept)

post.summary: Adds a message to an open request; the other party is told
Closes an open request
